Name: MORE Haley Revised - Seasonal - COMPLETED FESTIVAL OUTFITS
Author: smartichoke
Description:
Hi! I'm back again :)

I completed another set of festival outfits - this time for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11389]stanloona420's design of Haley[/url]! It functions exactly the same as their file, so follow their instructions
and use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Poltergeist's Seasonal Outfit[/url] mod to use the files.

THIS IS NOT A MOD, THIS IS JUST THE IMAGE FILES. You will need to replace the images within another mod to use them.

Due to stanloona420's files not containing all portrait expressions, I have decided to upload edited versions of ALL of the portraits. I really didn't want to include any files that were already in their mod, but for functionality I think they were necessary to include. Visually, they are nearly identical to the images you can see in their upload. I didn't feature them in any of the images because I thought it was a bit redundant.



[size=3]There are 2 versions![/size]

[list]
[*]The sprites in V1 are visually matched to the style that stanloona420 used in their files. You will need to download stanloona420's file to complete the set of sprites. I did not edit the sprites for their seasonal outfits.
[/list]
[list]
[*]The sprites in V2 are color matched to the portraits along with some personal preference edits. They are also noseless. There are additional files that contain the noses that can be configured in if you are using Poltergeist's Seasonal Outfit mod! This also includes sprites for the seasonal outfits for consistency.
[/list]
I listened to Chappell Roan on repeat while finishing these and that feels pretty fitting for Haley lol. Let me know if there are any inconsistencies or issues! I haven't had a chance to do a super in depth look within the game and all of the cutscenes to make sure everything looks right.
